claims.content: To restore a customer’s bidding privileges by removing their account from Review Status after resolving nonpayment issues, provided they have not exceeded the escalation policy threshold.

goal.raw_text: To restore a customer’s bidding privileges by removing their account from Review Status after resolving nonpayment issues, provided they have not exceeded the escalation policy threshold.

claims.content: Customer Service Representative
The customer’s account is in 'Review Status' due to unresolved (unpaid) auction winnings greater than 7 days old.
The Customer Service Representative has the ability to unlock accounts that are in 'Review Status'.

The customer has not exceeded the escalation policy threshold (i.e., failed to pay for auction winnings more than three times in a twelve-month period, unless three times is less than 10% of their total winnings).
If the customer previously used PayPal or Amazon Payments and had orders cancelled, they must update their account with a credit card before being removed from Review Status.
A customer contacts the call center to request unlocking of their account after having orders cancelled due to non-payment, provided they have not exceeded the escalation policy threshold.

trigger.raw_text: A customer contacts the call center to request unlocking of their account after having orders cancelled due to non-payment, provided they have not exceeded the escalation policy threshold.

claims.content: Customer Service Representative verifies the customer’s payment history and confirms that the account is in 'Review Status' due to unpaid auction winnings greater than 7 days old.

Customer Service Representative confirms that the customer has not exceeded the escalation policy threshold (i.e., failed to pay for auction winnings more than three times in a twelve-month period, unless three times is less than 10% of their total winnings).

If the customer previously used PayPal or Amazon Payments and had orders cancelled, Customer Service Representative ensures the customer has updated their account with a credit card before proceeding.
Customer Service Representative removes the customer’s account from 'Review Status', thereby restoring bidding privileges.
Customer Service Representative reminds the customer that winning an auction incurs an obligation to pay.

If the customer has failed to pay for auction winnings more than three times in a twelve-month period, and three times is not less than 10% of their total winnings, the Customer Service Representative cannot remove the account from Review Status — the customer is subject to the escalation policy and remains locked.

If the customer previously used PayPal or Amazon Payments and has not updated their account with a credit card after order cancellations, the Customer Service Representative cannot remove the account from Review Status until the payment method is updated.
If the customer’s order cancel rate is 10% or higher (and exceeds three unpaid orders in twelve months), they remain subject to the escalation policy and bidding privileges are not restored.

If the customer has failed to pay for auction winnings more than three times in a twelve-month period, and three times is not less than 10% of their total winnings, the Customer Service Representative cannot remove the account from Review Status — the customer remains subject to the escalation policy and bidding privileges are not restored.

If the customer previously used PayPal or Amazon Payments and has not updated their account with a credit card after order cancellations, the Customer Service Representative cannot remove the account from Review Status until the payment method is updated.
If the customer’s order cancel rate is 10% or higher (and exceeds three unpaid orders in twelve months), they remain subject to the escalation policy and bidding privileges are not restored.
The customer’s account is removed from 'Review Status'.
The customer’s bidding privileges are restored, allowing them to bid again.
If the customer previously used PayPal or Amazon Payments and had orders cancelled, their account must be updated with a credit card before removal from Review Status.
